_comment: Hand-picked camera poses, per map, in the five numbers SHOT_CAM and UG_BENCH_POSES both take:
px,py,pz,pitch,yaw (position in metres, rotation in degrees).
The GPU tier derives its own poses from the scene bounds, which is what makes it comparable across
maps; the cost of a frame, though, is a property of what was built there rather than of the bounding
box, so no fraction-of-extent pose lands on a dense street looking down its own length. These are
those views: expensive on purpose, deterministic, and the same numbers for the render measurement
and for the screenshot, so one A/B answers both 'is it faster' and 'does it look the same'.
To add one: run the game, fly to the view (FREECAM=1), press F4, and copy the SHOT_CAM value the
log prints. Name it after what makes it expensive, not after the map.
